review: Si Gregor is a hybrid user of Rupture and Poise; however, unlike Cinq Meursault, he prefers to be in a Poise team instead, as he will provide and gain more there. Let’s first talk about his unique statuses, starting with Serpent Arm which he gains from his Defensive Skill, Skill 2 and Skill 3. At turn end, it gives Gregor 3 Poise Potency and 2 Poise Count.If the target is affected with Rupture he will gain an additional 5 Poise Potency on base skill use. This status can stack up to 3 times and is reduced by 1 at turn end. His Second mechanic is Deathrite [Venom]. It is inflicted upon using Skill 2 and 3. It inflicts 1 Offense Level Down and 1 Defense Level Down upon getting Rupture triggered by a critical hit (up to 3 times per turn).
